name: smwmusic-super-mario-rpg-legend-of-the-seven-stars-a-new-friend
title: Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars - A New Friend
description:
(Unsampled version)
The fanfare that plays when a new party member joins you in SMRPG.

Includes a define to remove the echo. Which I recommend if you wish to use this as a global song (For example, bonus end) since the echo delay is very high ($0C).
